第二天，又开始了正常的学习、上课、看病。日子像钟摆一样，不紧不慢地晃着。政治课、解剖课、病理课，实验室里的切片和显微镜，诊室里的病人和病历本。王建新按部就班地过着，该干什么干什么，心静得像一池水。

八月八号，星期日。王建新早早请了假，教导员批得痛快，说“回家看看吧，你两个月没回去了”。王建新出了校门，坐上公交车，一路晃悠着往家的方向走。

到了他家附近，王建新下了车，拐进那条熟悉的胡同。胡同口的老槐树还在，树荫下有几个老头在下棋，棋子拍得啪啪响。王建新找了个没人的角落，从空间里取出三十斤白面、三十斤大米，面袋子鼓鼓囊囊的，米袋子也沉甸甸的。又拿出五斤猪肉、五斤羊肉，用油纸包着，冻得硬邦邦的。又拿出十个罐头——水果的、肉的都有，铁皮的，花花绿绿的标签。

东西不少，他两只手拎得满满当当的，面袋子搭在肩膀上，米袋子夹在腋下，罐头和肉用网兜拎着，走起路来叮叮当当的。

进了大杂院，前院的王大妈正在门口择豆角，看见王建新，眼睛一亮：“建新回来啦？哎呦，又拎这么多东西！”中院的刘婶探出头来，朝后院里喊了一嗓子“凤兰，你家建新回来了”。王建新一路打着招呼，进了后院。

大嫂正在院子里洗衣服，坐在小板凳上，搓衣板上搓着床单。她看见王建新拎着这么多东西，赶忙站起来，在围裙上擦了擦手，跑过来接过网兜里的罐头。罐头沉，她两只手捧着，嘴里说“三儿你咋又买这么多东西”。

大哥听见动静，从堂屋里出来，看见白面和大米，赶紧过来接。他一把扛起面袋子，一手拎起米袋子，嘴里说“三儿你这是把整个军人服务社搬回来了”。王建新笑了笑，没接话。

王建新来到堂屋。父亲坐在八仙桌旁边，手里夹着一根烟，面前的烟灰缸里堆了好几个烟头。母亲坐在旁边的椅子上，手里拿着一件衣服，低着头在缝，但针脚走得乱七八糟的。

妞妞第一个跑过来，扎着两个小揪揪，穿着一件小花裙子，脸蛋圆鼓鼓的，红扑扑的。她一把抱住王建新的腿，仰起头，笑得露出几颗小白牙，嘴里喊着“小叔小叔”。

王建新弯腰把妞妞抱起来，在脸蛋上使劲亲了一口，亲得妞妞咯咯直笑。然后从挎包里拿出一个苹果，红彤彤的，递给她。妞妞两只小手抱着苹果，啃了一口，啃下一小块皮，嚼了嚼。

小妹丽丽也从外面跑进来，一头汗，脸上还有泥。她看见妞妞手里的苹果，眼睛就亮了。王建新从挎包里又掏出一把糖果和一个苹果，递给她。丽丽接过糖和苹果，咧嘴笑了，露出两颗缺了的门牙。

王建新把东西放在八仙桌上——两条飞马，一条大前门，整整齐齐地摞着。然后他看了一眼母亲，母亲的眼眶红红的，好像哭过，眼睛还有点肿，眼皮耷拉着。父亲沉默地抽着烟，烟雾在堂屋里飘散，他一句话没说，眉头拧成了疙瘩。

王建新感觉到肯定发生什么事情了。

“妈，发生什么事了？”他问。

母亲没说话，低着头缝衣服，针扎进布里，又拔出来，再扎进去。她的嘴唇动了动，最后只说了句：“三儿，你想吃啥？妈给你做。”

王建新看了看屋里——二哥不在，他那个传说中的二嫂也不在。结婚这么长时间了，他到现在都没见过他的二嫂。上次回来二嫂回娘家了，这次回来还是不在。

The next day, normal study, classes, and medical treatment began again.The days swing slowly like a pendulum.Political classes, anatomy classes, pathology classes, slides and microscopes in the laboratory, patients and medical records in the clinic.Wang Jianxin lived his life step by step, doing whatever he had to do, and his mind was as calm as a pool of water.

August 8th, Sunday.Wang Jianxin asked for leave early, and the instructor approved it happily, saying, "Go home and take a look, you haven't been back for two months."Wang Jianxin left the school, got on the bus, and wandered toward home.

Arriving near his home, Wang Jianxin got out of the car and turned into the familiar alley.The old locust tree at the entrance of the alley is still there, and under the shade there are a few old men playing chess, with the chess pieces clicking loudly.Wang Jianxin found a deserted corner and took out thirty kilograms of white flour and thirty kilograms of rice from the space. The flour bag was bulging and the rice bag was also heavy.He also took out five kilograms of pork and five kilograms of mutton and wrapped them in oil paper until they were frozen hard.He took out ten more cans - both fruit and meat cans, tin-covered, with colorful labels.

There was a lot of stuff, and he carried it in both hands. The flour bag was placed on his shoulders, the rice bag was tucked under his arm, and the cans and meat were carried in a net bag, which made a jingling sound when he walked.

Entering the courtyard, Aunt Wang in the front yard was picking beans at the door. When she saw Wang Jianxin, her eyes lit up: "Jianxin is back? Oops, carrying so many things again!" Aunt Liu in the middle yard stuck her head out and shouted into the backyard, "Fenglan, your Jianxin is back."Wang Jianxin greeted everyone and entered the backyard.

My sister-in-law was washing clothes in the yard, sitting on a small bench, rubbing the sheets on the washboard.When she saw Wang Jianxin carrying so many things, she quickly stood up, wiped her hands on her apron, and ran over to take the cans in the net bag.The can was heavy. She held it in both hands and said, "San'er, why did you buy so many things again?"

The eldest brother heard the noise and came out of the main room. He saw the white noodles and rice and hurried over to pick them up.He picked up the flour bag in one hand and the rice bag in the other, and said, "San'er, you have moved the entire Military Service Co., Ltd. back."Wang Jianxin smiled and did not answer.

Wang Jianxin came to the main room.My father was sitting next to the Eight Immortals table with a cigarette in his hand and several cigarette butts piled in the ashtray in front of him.My mother was sitting on the chair next to her, holding a piece of clothing in her hand. She was sewing with her head down, but the stitches came out in a mess.

Niu Niu was the first one to run over, wearing two little knots and a small floral skirt, with a round and rosy face.She hugged Wang Jianxin's legs, raised her head, smiled so much that her little white teeth were exposed, and shouted "Uncle, little uncle".

Wang Jianxin bent down to pick up Niu Niu and kissed her hard on the face, which made Niu Niu giggle.Then he took out a red apple from his bag and handed it to her.Niu Niu held the apple in her two little hands, took a bite, took off a small piece of skin, and chewed it.

The younger sister Lili also ran in from outside, sweating and with mud on her face.When she saw the apple in Niu Niu's hand, her eyes lit up.Wang Jianxin took out another handful of candies and an apple from his satchel and handed them to her.Lili took the candy and apple and grinned, showing her two missing front teeth.

Wang Jianxin put things on the Eight Immortals table - two Pegasus and a large front door, neatly stacked.Then he glanced at his mother. Her eyes were red, as if she had cried, her eyes were a little swollen, and her eyelids were drooped.The father smoked in silence, the smoke drifting away in the main room. He didn't say a word, and his brows were knitted into knots.

Wang Jianxin felt that something must have happened.

"Mom, what happened?" he asked.

Mother didn't say anything. She lowered her head and sewed, inserting the needle into the cloth, pulling it out, and then inserting it again.Her lips moved, and finally she just said: "San'er, what do you want to eat? Mom will cook it for you."

Wang Jianxin looked around the room - his second brother was not there, and neither was his legendary second sister-in-law.After being married for such a long time, he has never seen his second sister-in-law.My second sister-in-law went back to her parents' home last time, but she's still not here this time.
